lead.hed: USNI: Fleet and Marine Tracker for Sept. 8
lead.insight: USNI News, Tuesday: the weekly tracker plots approximate positions of deployed U.S. carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups as of Sept. 8, 2026, from Navy and public data. When a group is disaggregated, the chart uses the capital ship.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo · DVIDS 9872029 · Public domain · An F-35C Lightning II on USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72), Aug. 11, 2026.

political.hed: USNI: North Korea commissions a second Choe Hyon-class destroyer
political.insight: USNI News, Tuesday: Pyongyang commissioned Kang Kon (52) at Wonsan, with Kim Jong Un overseeing the ceremony, according to KCNA as reported by USNI.

political.hed: Defense News: Iran says it captured a U.S. uncrewed submersible
political.insight: Defense News, Wednesday: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said Tuesday they captured a U.S. uncrewed submarine at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz. The Pentagon said the craft had malfunctioned more than a day earlier.

political.hed: Defense News: Ukraine races faster interceptor drones
political.insight: Defense News, Wednesday: Ukrainian firms are pushing interceptor drones to keep up with Russian jet-powered drones. The piece is industry reporting, not a signed U.S. order.

tech.hed: Heritage: China is working the U.S. fight over AI data centers
tech.insight: Heritage Foundation: the essay says CCP-linked actors have amplified U.S. local fights over AI data centers, treating power prices and siting fights as a way to slow American compute. It is commentary, not a new statute.

tech.hed: Law & Liberty: hearts, minds, and dollar signs
tech.insight: Law & Liberty, Wednesday: aspiring builders do have a problem, the essay says, but democracy is not it. Forum piece, not a bill.

culture.insight: TruthScript, Tuesday: the essay tracks how celebrity often ends in suicide, alcohol, or overdose, and treats fame as a spiritual hazard rather than a prize.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: adjudicating history and tradition
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Wednesday: a Massachusetts case is used to warn against abuses of history in legal rulings. Essay, not a Supreme Court opinion.
